Large Ganja and Cash Seizures Reported in Andhra Pradesh and Odisha

Authorities in Andhra Pradesh seized ganja valued at Rs 3 crore and arrested three individuals. In a separate incident in Puri, Odisha, approximately 100 kg of ganja and cash were confiscated from a rented house, leading to the detention of two people. Another seizure in Odisha involved 183 kg of ganja and Rs 64.5 lakh in cash, with two individuals apprehended.
